The '''Moravia system''' was located in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the martial arts technique known as the [[Moravian maneuver]].<ref name="Trapped">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Moravian maneuver]]|system=Moravia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Moravia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square Q-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
